# kaal:claim:6655138-035

**Claim.** The expected coverage of the joint possibility space generated by n agents under the composition operator strictly exceeds the expected coverage of the union of their individual possibility spaces whenever at least one quality dimension is super-additive in agent collaboration.

**Type.** mechanism  **Support.** argued

**Holds when.**

- at least one quality dimension is super-additive in collaboration
- senior-reputation validator pools are non-empty

**Source quote.**

> The expected coverage of the joint possibility space generated by n agents under the composition operator Φ strictly exceeds the expected coverage of the union of their individual possibility spaces, when at least one quality dimension is super-additive in agent collaboration.

**From.** Wulf A. Kaal, *Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems* (2026), IX.B Proposition 2 (Compositional gain), page 23
